---
name: story-continuity
description: Audit Storydex story continuity and fact provenance across characters, chapters, memory, scripts, and story time. Use before high-reasoning story generation, after chapter edits, or when facts, chronology, knowledge boundaries, or character state may conflict.
---

# Story Continuity

1. Separate objective facts from what the protagonist and each character know.
2. Check current location, injuries, possessions, relationships, unresolved causes, story time, active scripts, and locked facts.
3. Trace uncertain variables to chapter or project-file sources. Mark unsupported memory stale instead of inventing a resolution.
4. Respect flashback time separately from the main current time. Do not reveal unreached script material.
5. Resolve conflicts by priority: locked fact, current project file, later high-priority preset, established chapter evidence, conversational recall.
6. Return concise generation constraints or a structured state delta; do not produce a second version of the scene unless asked.
